title: Skinwalkers at the Pentagon on AATIP and remote viewing

tellings.quote: i was just reading skin walkers at the pentagon you know where it talks about atip and and i guess yeah awesome these two programs uh and it looks like remote viewing is sort of again revived

plain: The book Skinwalkers at the Pentagon describes AATIP, a small Pentagon office that studied unexplained aerial reports, alongside a related programme, and suggests that remote viewing, the claimed ability to see distant places with the mind alone, was 'sort of again revived' there, according to Jesse Michels. He mentions it himself, saying he was just reading the book, while talking with a guest.
